description: This file defines a fragment (`DeviceListFragment`) for an Android application that manages and displays a list of Wi-Fi Direct peers. It handles discovery of nearby devices, displays their status, and initiates connection events through an interface. The class uses Android system components such as `ListFragment`, `ProgressDialog`, and Wi-Fi P2P API classes like `WifiP2pDevice`.

classes.name: DeviceListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays available Wi-Fi Direct peers, manages peer discovery results, and handles user interaction for Wi-Fi Direct device selection.

classes.name: WiFiPeerListAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter to display Wi-Fi P2P devices, showing device name and status.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter with the current list of peers.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the currently selected Wi-Fi P2P device.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Converts device status codes into human-readable strings.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the device list, prompting the parent activity to show device details.

methods.name: updateThisDevice
methods.description: Updates the UI to show the details of this device.

methods.name: onPeersAvailable
methods.description: Called when a list of available peers is discovered; updates the internal list and UI.

methods.name: clearPeers
methods.description: Clears the list of available peers.

methods.name: onInitiateDiscovery
methods.description: Starts or updates the peer discovery progress dialog.
